# Northern Elephant Seal

 Mirounga angustirostris 

Abstract

 Northern Elephant Seal Mirounga angustirostris has most recently been assessed for The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species in 2014. Mirounga angustirostris is listed as Least Concern.
